assumptions.data: Yahoo Finance adjusted close via chart endpoint
assumptions.rebalance: Monthly for trend/momentum rules; daily state update for RSI rule
assumptions.lookahead: Signals use data available before the return day

results.name: Buy & Hold SPY
results.description: Always long SPY as a passive market benchmark.

results.name: SPY 200D Trend Timing
results.description: Long SPY only when SPY closes above its 200-day average; otherwise in SHY.

results.name: 12M Time-Series Momentum Basket
results.description: Monthly equal-weight basket of assets with positive 12-month momentum; idle capital goes to SHY.

results.name: Dual Momentum Top-3
results.description: Monthly rotation into the top three 12-month momentum assets only if each is above its 200-day average; otherwise SHY.

results.name: SPY 2-Day RSI Mean Reversion
results.description: Long SPY after very short-term oversold readings, exit to SHY after rebound.

best.name: Buy & Hold SPY
best.description: Always long SPY as a passive market benchmark.
